lines.japanese: 「いらっしゃいませ！　アレキサンダーへようこそ！」
lines.english: “Welcome! Welcome to Alexander!”

lines.japanese: 一日空けてのアレキサンダー。最近は常勤の皆さまより顔を出している気がします。
lines.english: Back at Alexander after only a day away. Lately, I seemed to be showing my face more often than some of the full-time staff.

lines.japanese: さていつまで続くものやら。なんて自分でも思いますが、居心地いいんすよねえ今の状態。
lines.english: Who knows how long this'll last? I wonder about that myself, but... I'm pretty comfortable with how things are right now.

lines.japanese: しかし、いつまでも俺だけヘルプ扱いでふわふわしてて良いのでしょうか。うーん、どうしたもんでしょう。
lines.english: Was it really all right, though, to drift along forever as temporary help? Hmm. What was I going to do?

lines.japanese: ぷるるるるるる　ぷるるるるるる
lines.english: Rrrrrring. Rrrrrring.

lines.japanese: 「おっと」
lines.english: “Whoops.”

lines.japanese: 「はいアレキサンダー花水木通り店です」
lines.english: “Alexander, Hanamizuki Street branch. How may I help you?”

lines.japanese: アレキサンダーでは役職の区別なく、電話が鳴れば近くのスタッフが対応することになっています。俺は手近にあった受話器を取りあげました。
lines.english: At Alexander, rank made no difference: when the phone rang, whichever staff member was nearest answered it. I picked up the receiver beside me.

lines.japanese: 「あっ……鷲介さんですか？」
lines.english: “Oh... Is that Shusuke?”

lines.japanese: 「え？　ああ、これ内線か」
lines.english: “What? Oh, it's an internal call.”

lines.japanese: 電話機を確認すると『内線』ランプが緑色に点灯していました。
lines.english: I checked the phone and found the green INTERNAL light glowing.

lines.japanese: 「あの、私です。玉泉です」
lines.english: “Um, it's me. Tamaizumi.”

lines.japanese: 「ああ、タマちゃん？」
lines.english: “Oh, Tammy?”

lines.japanese: 「切りますよ」
lines.english: “I'm hanging up.”

lines.japanese: 「ご、ごめんなさい！　ちょっと調子に乗りました！　いやいや、お仕事の指示ですよね、喜んで！」
lines.english: “S-sorry! I got a little carried away! Right, right—you have work instructions for me. I'm at your service!”

lines.japanese: 「あっ、いえその、仕事じゃないんですけど……」
lines.english: “Oh, no. It isn't about work...”

lines.japanese: 日和子さんは周りを気にするかのように、声のトーンを一段下げました。
lines.english: As though wary of being overheard, Hiyoko lowered her voice another notch.

lines.japanese: 「あ、あの、昨日言ってたアレ持ってきたんですけど」
lines.english: “U-um, I brought that thing we talked about yesterday.”

lines.japanese: 「アレ？」
lines.english: “That thing?”

lines.japanese: 「です。あの、帰り道に話した……」
lines.english: “Yes. The one we discussed on the way home...”

lines.japanese: ああ、そういえば日和子さん、お勧めの本を貸してくれるって言ってたっけ。
lines.english: Oh, right. Hiyoko had promised to lend me a book she recommended.

lines.japanese: 「わはー、本当に持ってきてくれたんすね！」
lines.english: “Wow! You really brought it!”

lines.japanese: 「まあ、一応普段から持ってはいるんで……あ、それで、今すぐ事務所の方にきていただければと……」
lines.english: “Well, I usually carry it with me anyway... So, um, could you come up to the office now...?”

lines.japanese: 「いや、いっすよ、帰りでも。今まだ仕事中ですし」
lines.english: “It can wait until we leave. We're still working.”

lines.japanese: なにせ彼女は、業務中の私語さえ厭う、地獄の鬼教官だからな。
lines.english: After all, she was the taskmaster from hell, a woman who frowned on so much as idle chatter during work.

lines.japanese: 「駄目です。帰りだと困るんで、今すぐに来てください」
lines.english: “No. Waiting until afterward would be a problem. Please come now.”

lines.japanese: 「え、ええっ？」
lines.english: “W-what?”

lines.japanese: あの玉泉トレーナーが、就業時間中に仕事をほっぽってでも来いって？　どどど、どういうことだろう。
lines.english: Coach Tamaizumi herself wanted me to abandon my post and come upstairs in the middle of a shift? Wh-wh-what could this mean?

lines.japanese: 「それとも何か手の離せない仕事をしてるんですか？」
lines.english: “Unless you're in the middle of something you can't leave?”

lines.japanese: 「いえ、別にそういうわけじゃ……」
lines.english: “No, it's nothing like that...”

lines.japanese: 「じゃあお願いします。急いでくださいね」
lines.english: “Then please come. And hurry.”

lines.japanese: そこで一方的に電話を切られてしまいました。仕方ない、急いで行きましょう。
lines.english: With that, she ended the call. No choice, then. I would have to hurry.

lines.japanese: 俺は受話器を置くと、さっそく階段へ向かいました。
lines.english: I set down the receiver and headed straight for the stairs.

lines.japanese: 「ん？　鷲介、おまえも二階へ行くのか」
lines.english: “Hmm? Shusuke, are you going upstairs too?”

lines.japanese: そのとき隣りに並んだのは背の高い無精ヒゲ。
lines.english: The tall, stubbled man fell into step beside me.

lines.japanese: 「あれ、マスターもですか？」
lines.english: “Oh, are you going too, boss?”

lines.japanese: 「うむ。最近物忘れが酷くなってきてな、俺のビデオラックに鍵を掛けわすれた気がするのだ」
lines.english: “Indeed. My memory has been failing me terribly of late. I fear I may have neglected to lock my video cabinet.”

lines.japanese: 「あんなものを女性店員、ことに玉泉君にでも見られたら、俺の威厳というものが地に落ちてしまう」
lines.english: “If one of the female employees—especially Ms. Tamaizumi—were to see its contents, my dignity would be ground into the dust.”

lines.japanese: 「いえ、心配しなくてもアナタの信用はとっくの昔にイカロスの翼ですよ。ていうか俺、日和子さんに呼ばれて事務室に行くとこなんすけど」
lines.english: “Don't worry. Your reputation went the way of Icarus ages ago. Anyway, Hiyoko called me to the office.”

lines.japanese: 「なにっ！　おい鷲介、それを先に言え。まずい、鍵をかけ忘れただけならまだしも、どうも机の上に鍵ごと出しっぱなしにしておいた可能性が高い」
lines.english: “What! Shusuke, you should have said so at once. This is bad. Forget merely leaving it unlocked—I may well have left the key lying on the desk beside it.”

lines.japanese: 「急げ鷲介！　このままじゃ、俺たちは女性陣に嫌われてしまうぜ！」
lines.english: “Hurry, Shusuke! At this rate, the ladies will hate us!”

lines.japanese: マスターは腕をぶんぶん振ってスピードアップを促してきました。元気だなあ。
lines.english: The boss windmilled his arms, urging me to pick up the pace. Such energy.

lines.japanese: 「大丈夫っすよ。マスターは嫌われるっていうより、呆れられるの部類ですし。ね、お客さんの迷惑になりますから走るのやめましょう」
lines.english: “We'll be fine. With you, it's less that they hate you and more that they're fed up with you. Hey, stop running. You're bothering the customers.”

lines.japanese: 「む、意外と落ちついているんだな。貴様、我々のプライベートが玉泉君に知られてもいいと言うのか」
lines.english: “Hmm. You are strangely calm. Are you saying you don't mind Ms. Tamaizumi discovering our private affairs?”

lines.japanese: 「いやまあ、今さら焦っても仕方ないっすよ。ていうか自業自得でしょう」
lines.english: “There's no point panicking now. Besides, you brought it on yourself.”

lines.japanese: マスターはさも意外そうな顔をして首を捻りました。
lines.english: The boss tilted his head, looking thoroughly surprised.

lines.japanese: 「なんだおまえ、本当に急がなくてもいいというのか」
lines.english: “What's this? Do you truly mean there is no need to hurry?”

lines.japanese: 「だって俺には関わりないことすから。マスターこそ急いだ方がいいんじゃないすか」
lines.english: “It's got nothing to do with me. You're the one who ought to hurry.”

lines.japanese: 「そうなのか……ちなみに俺のビデオラックの中身には、万が一のため全てに千歳鷲介と記名してあるが、おまえがそこまで言うなら止むをえんな」
lines.english: “Is that so...? As a precaution, I labeled every item in my video cabinet ‘Property of Shusuke Chitose.’ But if you insist, there is nothing to be done.”

lines.japanese: <10>\「おまえの物が俺の物！？」
lines.english: “What's yours is mine!?”

lines.japanese: 「そ、そんな重大なことをいまここで暴露されても！　ちょっ、なに人の名前勝手に使ってんすかマスター！　す、すいません、そこどいて！　通して！　通してください！」
lines.english: “Y-you can't casually reveal something that catastrophic now! Why are you using my name without permission, boss? S-sorry, coming through! Let me pass! Please let me pass!”

lines.japanese: 「こらこら、お客様の迷惑になるから店内を走るんじゃない。今さら焦っても仕方ないし自業自得だろう。そんなことじゃ女どもに、安い男はがっついてばかりだと笑われてしまうぜ？」
lines.english: “Now, now. Don't run indoors and disturb the customers. There's no point panicking now, and you brought it on yourself. Carry on like that and the ladies will laugh that cheap men are always so desperate.”

lines.japanese: 「ああもう、得意げな笑顔が憎たらしいことこの上ない！　そんな無駄に手間のかかる仕込みいつしたんすか！　つーか俺、今度からアナタのビデオラックの管理までしなくちゃいけないんすか！」
lines.english: “Oh, God, that smug grin of yours couldn't be more annoying! When did you even set up something this pointlessly elaborate? And now I have to keep track of your video rack too?”

lines.japanese: 「馬鹿な、おまえなどにこの俺のプライベートを守る鍵を渡せるものか。観たいときは直接俺のところに言ってこい」
lines.english: “Don't be absurd. As if I could entrust the key to my private life to the likes of you. If you wish to watch something, come and ask me directly.”

lines.japanese: 「ええ、言いたいことは山ほどありますからね！　あとで言わせてもらいますけどね！　とにかくいまは急がないと！」
lines.english: “Oh, I have plenty I'd like to ask you! And you'll hear all of it later! Right now, we have to hurry!”

lines.japanese: 「おやっ？　ようくここを見たまえ千歳君、顔を近づけねば分からんほどの些細な汚れが手すりにあるよ？　ははははキミたち、ちゃんと掃除はしているのかね？」
lines.english: “Oh? Look closely here, Mr. Chitose. There is a tiny smudge on the railing, so small one must bring one's face quite near to see it. Ha ha ha! Do you people clean this place properly?”

lines.japanese: 「急にのんびりしないでくださいよ！　お願いだから早く！　早く事務室に！」
lines.english: “Don't suddenly start dawdling! Please, hurry! Get to the office!”

lines.japanese: 俺は二階へ上がると同時に、スタッフルームのドアへ飛びつきました。
lines.english: The instant I reached the second floor, I flung myself at the staff-room door.

lines.japanese: 「日和子さん！」
lines.english: “Hiyoko!”

lines.japanese: ……あれ？
lines.english: ...Huh?

lines.japanese: 中を見渡しても誰の姿も見当たらず。でもいまフロアにもいなかった……よなあ？
lines.english: I looked around, but there was nobody inside. Yet she hadn't been out on the floor either... had she?

lines.japanese: 「日和子さーん？」
lines.english: “Hiyokooo?”

lines.japanese: <-5>\「あ、あの鷲介さん、あまり大きな声を出さないでください」
lines.english: “U-um, Shusuke, please don't call out so loudly.”

lines.japanese: 「ええっ！　姿はないけど声はする！？　日和子さんたら、いつの間にそんな文字通りのかくし芸を！？」
lines.english: “What! I can hear you, but I can't see you! Hiyoko, when did vanishing become one of your hidden talents?”

lines.japanese: <-5>\「お、大きな声を出さないでください！　ここです、こっちです」
lines.english: “D-don't be so loud! I'm here. Over here.”

lines.japanese: よく注意して耳を凝らせば、ドアが閉まっているので聞こえにくかったのですが、更衣室の中から声がします。
lines.english: When I stopped and listened carefully, I heard her voice coming from inside the changing room, muffled by the closed door.

lines.japanese: 「ずいぶん用心深いんすね……」
lines.english: “You're being awfully cautious...”

lines.japanese: なんだか麻薬や拳銃の受け渡しでもするのかってぐらい遠まわりです。
lines.english: She was taking enough elaborate precautions for a handoff of drugs or firearms.

lines.japanese: 勤務時間中に本の受け渡しぐらいしたって誰も怒らないだろうに、日和子さんはそこまでひとに見られたくないようです。まあ、普段が風紀委員キャラだから仕方ないか。
lines.english: No one would scold us merely for exchanging a book during work, yet Hiyoko was determined not to be seen. Then again, she usually played the strict hall monitor, so perhaps it couldn't be helped.

lines.japanese: 「おい鷲介、どうした。俺たちのＤＶＤは無事机の上にあったのか」
lines.english: “Shusuke, what happened? Were our DVDs safe on the desk?”

lines.japanese: あ。忘れてた。
lines.english: Oh. I’d forgotten.

lines.japanese: 後ろからゆっくり歩いてきたマスターが、スタッフルームに入ってきました。
lines.english: The boss, who had sauntered up behind me, entered the staff room.
“What?”

lines.japanese: 「いや見ての通り机の上にはなにもないっすよ」
lines.english: “As you can see, there's nothing on the desk.”

lines.japanese: 「ほほう、そうか。俺たちのＤＶＤが無事でよかったな」
lines.english: “Ah, excellent. I'm glad our DVDs are safe.”

lines.japanese: 「だから、アナタ個人のものだって言ってるでしょう。古本屋呼んで全部売っぱらいますよ」
lines.english: “I keep telling you, they belong to you alone. I'll call a secondhand shop and sell the lot.”

lines.japanese: <-5>\「あ、あの、店長もいるんですか？」
lines.english: “Um... Is the Manager there too?”

lines.japanese: 「え？　ええ、いますけど？」
lines.english: “What? Yes, he is.”

lines.japanese: <-5>\「あ……じゃ、じゃあまたあとでっ」
lines.english: “Oh... Th-then I'll speak to you later!”

lines.japanese: 「へっ？　あれ、日和子さん？」
lines.english: “Huh? Wait, Hiyoko?”

lines.japanese: しかしそれきり日和子さんは黙ってしまいました。玉泉日和子などここにはいない、話しかけるな、という波動が壁越しに伝わってきます。
lines.english: But Hiyoko fell silent and said no more. Even through the wall, I could feel the waves she was emitting: *There is no Hiyoko Tamaizumi here. Do not address her.*

lines.japanese: うーん、ほんと用心深い。でも仕方ない、マスターには日和子さんのこと黙っててあげよう。
lines.english: Hmm. She really was being cautious. No help for it. I would keep her presence secret from the boss.

lines.japanese: 「どうした鷲介。更衣室に盗撮機など仕掛けられては、いくら俺とおまえの仲でも法的措置を取らねばならん。壁にコップを付けて聞き耳たてるぐらいで我慢しておけ」
lines.english: “What is it, Shusuke? If you've installed a hidden camera in the changing room, even our friendship won't stop me from hauling you in red-handed. Content yourself with putting a glass to the wall and listening.”

lines.japanese: 「ハイハイそっすね。んじゃ俺、仕事に戻りますんで」
lines.english: “Sure, sure. Anyway, I'm going back to work.”

lines.japanese: 「おっと鷲介、今なら誰もいないし、俺の秘蔵のＤＶＤを一本ぐらい持って行ってもいいぞ」
lines.english: “Wait, Shusuke. No one else is here, so you may take one of the treasures from my DVD collection.”

lines.japanese: 「い、いりませんよそんなもん。中学生じゃあるまいし」
lines.english: “I-I don't want that stuff. I'm not in middle school.”

lines.japanese: 「ふふん、強がりやがって。ここに玉泉君がいるわけでもなし、素直になれよ」
lines.english: “Hmph. Playing tough, are you? Ms. Tamaizumi isn't here. Be honest with yourself.”

lines.japanese: いるんですけどね、すぐそこに。
lines.english: She was, actually. Right over there.

lines.japanese: まあ確かに日和子さんさえ居なければ、俺だって男の子だからＤＶＤの一枚くらいは借りてもよかったんですけど。
lines.english: Admittedly, if Hiyoko truly hadn't been there, I was still a guy, and I might have borrowed a DVD or two.

lines.japanese: ん、待てよ？　日和子さんがここを通ったってのに、職場に持ちこまれたいかがわしいＤＶＤを完璧に無視？　そんなことがありうるのでしょうか。
lines.english: Wait a second. Hiyoko came through here and completely ignored all these sketchy DVDs someone brought into work? Is that even possible?

lines.japanese: 「見ろ、今月の新作が昨日さっそく送られてきたばかりでな……むっ？」
lines.english: “Look. This month's new releases only arrived yesterday... Hmm?”

lines.japanese: 「どうしました」
lines.english: “What is it?”

lines.japanese: 俺が振りむくと、マスターのビデオラックの中は空になっていました。ああ、やはり。
lines.english: I turned around. The boss's video cabinet was empty. Ah. Just as I thought.

lines.japanese: 「な、なんだこれは。一体どういうことなんだ」
lines.english: “Wh-what is this? What in the world has happened?”

lines.japanese: 「あのうマスター、いま気付いたんすけど、窓の下になんか見慣れないゴミ袋が三つほど積まれてますが……」
lines.english: “Um, boss, I only just noticed, but there are three unfamiliar garbage bags piled beneath the window...”
“What!?”

lines.japanese: それは丁度ゴミ収集車に積まれて運ばれていくところでした。
lines.english: At that exact moment, a garbage truck lifted them aboard and carried them away.

lines.japanese: 「馬鹿な……！　俺の１９年間が……！」
lines.english: “Impossible...! Nineteen years of my life...!”

lines.japanese: 「まあ、お気の毒ですが……本部に報告されるよりは良心的な沙汰だと思いますよ……」
lines.english: “You have my sympathy... but I'd say throwing them away was merciful compared with reporting you to headquarters.”

lines.japanese: ものの本で読んだのですが、職場で女性の目が触れるところにそういうものを置いておくのは、セクハラ行為として立件できる可能性もあるそうです。恐いですねー。気を付けましょう。
lines.english: I had read somewhere that leaving such material where female employees might see it could potentially constitute sexual harassment. Frightening stuff. Let us all take care.

lines.japanese: 「続いてのニュースです」
lines.english: “And now, our next story.”

lines.japanese: 「美空区柳木原・花水木通りの一角で、近年参加者が減少傾向にある『乱れ髪おんな祭り』を見直そうという動きが表れているようです」
lines.english: “In one corner of Hanamizuki Street, Yanagihara, Misora Ward, a movement is under way to revive the ‘Wild-Haired Women's Festival,’ whose attendance has declined in recent years.”

lines.japanese: 「実行委員長を務める飲食店経営・軽部狩男さんは『元始、女性は裸体であった』『ふんどしは誇るべき日本の文化』『無気力な若者たちに新しい風を起こしたい』などとして、全国の有志に広く呼びかけています」
lines.english: “Karuo Karube, restaurant owner and chairman of the organizing committee, issued a nationwide call for volunteers, declaring that ‘In the beginning, woman was naked,’ ‘The loincloth is a proud part of Japanese culture,’ and ‘I want to bring a new wind to today's apathetic youth.’”

lines.japanese: 「なお調べによりますと、この男は以前にも『女子スタッフ全員半袖ブラウスで吊革フェスティバル』の開催をくわだて──」
lines.english: “Our investigation further revealed that the same man previously plotted an ‘All-Female Staff Short-Sleeved Blouse and Overhead-Strap Festival’—”

lines.japanese: 「──近隣からは『手淫手淫とうるさい』『玄関の燃えるゴミ捨ててきてください』『横ぴーす』などの苦情が寄せられる微笑ましい一幕も見られました」
lines.english: “—an endearing episode that drew complaints from local residents including, ‘Stop shouting “jerk off, jerk off” all day,’ ‘Please take the burnable trash outside,’ and ‘Sideways peace sign.’”

lines.japanese: それにしても……さっきの日和子さん、どうしたんだろうなあ。
lines.english: Still... what was up with Hiyoko back there?

lines.japanese: 俺は日和子さんを置き去りに、ひとり一階のフロアで仕事を始めていました。
lines.english: Leaving her behind, I began work alone on the ground floor.

lines.japanese: 「千歳ー、店長とたまひよは？」
lines.english: “Chitose—where are the Manager and Tama-chick?”

lines.japanese: 「は？　店長なら事務室で生放送中ですけど、日和子さんは知りませんよ」
lines.english: “Huh? The Manager is broadcasting live from the office, but I don't know where Hiyoko is.”

lines.japanese: ていうか、俺も日和子さん探してるし。遠回りなことしないで、さっさと本貸してほしいんだよな。
lines.english: I mean, I'm looking for Hiyoko too. I wish she'd quit beating around the bush and just lend me the book already.

lines.japanese: 「あー、参ったな。いつもならこの時間混まないのに、お客さんが大量に来て手が足りないんだよ。千歳もちょっとこっち手伝って」
lines.english: “Aw, hell. We're never busy at this hour, but a whole crowd just showed up and we're short-handed. Chitose, come give me a hand.”

lines.japanese: 「あ、はいはいすぐに」
lines.english: “Right. I'm coming.”

lines.japanese: 俺は英里子さんに連れられて、しばらくフロアの作業に掛かりきりとなってしまいました。
lines.english: Eriko dragged me along, and for a while the work on the floor demanded every bit of my attention.

lines.japanese: 日和子さんのことは気になるけど……ま、同じ店にいるんだし、そのうち会うだろう。
lines.english: Hiyoko was still on my mind... but we were in the same restaurant. I was bound to run into her eventually.

lines.japanese: 団体で来たお客様の対応も落ちついて、ようやく一息つけるくらいには落ちつきました。
lines.english: We finally finished dealing with the party of customers and reached a point where we could catch our breath.

lines.japanese: 「はー、結構しんどかったすねえ……」
lines.english: “Whew. That was pretty rough...”

lines.japanese: 今日は社員スタッフさんの一人が急用で遅れるとの連絡があったため、ちょいと人手も不足気味でした。
lines.english: One of the full-time staff had called to say something urgent would make him late, so we were a little short-handed today.

lines.japanese: そんな中で英里子さんはいつも以上の働きを見せ、俺みたいな新人への指示もこなしつつ、マスターとの連携も計るという、まさしく八面六臂の活躍をしてくれました。
lines.english: In the middle of all that, Eriko worked even harder than usual, directing a rookie like me while coordinating with the Manager—truly doing the work of six people at once.

lines.japanese: 「お疲れ様です、英里子さん」
lines.english: “Nice work, Eriko.”

lines.japanese: 「ま、ときどきあるんだよこういうの。つっても、この程度で音ぇ上げてたら、クリスマス前なんかこれどこじゃないしね」
lines.english: “Eh, this happens sometimes. And if this is enough to make you whine, the rush before Christmas will eat you alive.”

lines.japanese: でもそれをいかにも大変な風に見せないのが、英里子さんの偉いところです。
lines.english: What made Eriko admirable was how little she let any of it look difficult.

lines.japanese: 「てか、結局たまひよ見つからなかったね。千歳、どうなってんだよ」
lines.english: “Anyway, we never did find Tama-chick. Chitose, what gives?”

lines.japanese: 「てか、なんで日和子さんのことを俺に聞くんすか」
lines.english: “Why are you asking me where Hiyoko is?”

lines.japanese: 「てか、だっておまえの保護者だろ。なに、それとも、聞かれちゃ困ることでもあんのククク」
lines.english: “Because you're her guardian, aren't you? What, is there some reason you'd rather I didn't ask? Heh heh heh.”

lines.japanese: 「な、なんすかその狩男らしい笑みは。べべべつに困ることなんかないっすよ」
lines.english: “Wh-what's with that Karuo-like grin? There's n-nothing I don't want you asking.”

lines.japanese: 「つーかさ、どうなの最近。進展あったの？　ちょっとお姉さんに報告してみ」
lines.english: “So how are things lately? Made any progress? Come on, tell your big sister all about it.”

lines.japanese: 「や、むしろ俺が客観的意見を聞きたいんすよ。どうなんすか、進んでるように見えますか」
lines.english: “If anything, I'm the one who wants an objective opinion. How does it look to you? Are we making progress?”

lines.japanese: 「知らないよ。ここんとこ私も忙しくて、千歳で遊んでる暇もなかったし」
lines.english: “How should I know? I've been so busy lately, I haven't even had time to play with Chitose.”

lines.japanese: 「本人を目の前にして遊んでるとか言わないでください。いや、目の前じゃなくても困りますけど」
lines.english: “Could you not talk about playing with me when I'm standing right here? Actually, I'd rather you didn't say it when I'm not here either.”

lines.japanese: 「ていうか、どのくらい進展してるかなんて、ハタから見ただけじゃ分かんないって。たまひよが内股で歩きにくそーにしてるとかならまだしも」
lines.english: “Anyway, you can't tell how far they've gone just by looking. Maybe if Mother Hen were walking pigeon-toed because it hurt or something.”

lines.japanese: 「あのう、そういう生々しい冗談やめてもらえます？」
lines.english: “Um, could you please stop making jokes that graphic?”

lines.japanese: 「はあ？　こんぐらいで生々しいっておまえ、まだ雷に怯える女がいいとか言ってんの？　いねーいねー、ぜってーいねー！　いまどきそんなんいるわきゃねー！」
lines.english: “Huh? You call that graphic? What, are you still holding out for some girl who trembles at thunder? She doesn't exist! Definitely doesn't exist! Nobody like that exists these days!”

lines.japanese: 「ちょっとお！　誰っ、このひと放し飼いにしたの！」
lines.english: “Hey! Who let this woman off her leash?”

lines.japanese: 「でー？　そういう英里子さんの方こそどうなんすか。最近浮いた話とかないんすか？」
lines.english: “Sooo? What about you, Eriko? Any romance in your life lately?”

lines.japanese: 「あァ？　私？」
lines.english: “Huh? Me?”

lines.japanese: 「ん……そういやここんトコそーゆー話ないね。あれ、なんで？」
lines.english: “Hmm… Come to think of it, there hasn't been anything lately. Wait. Why not?”

lines.japanese: 「いや、俺に聞かれても」
lines.english: “Don't ask me.”

lines.japanese: 「おかしいなあ、なんか私に問題でもあんの？　千歳ちょっと、心当たりない？」
lines.english: “That's weird. Is there something wrong with me? Chitose, any ideas?”

lines.japanese: 「だから前にも言ったじゃないすか。英里子さんの問題は一点に集約されてるんすよ」
lines.english: “I told you before. Your problem boils down to one thing.”

lines.japanese: 「化粧の仕方なら変えたじゃん」
lines.english: “I changed how I do my makeup.”

lines.japanese: 「そっちなんだ！　じゃあ二点ですよ！」
lines.english: “That was your guess!? Fine—two things!”

lines.japanese: 「てめ、一点とか二点とか私を偉そうに評価すんな、何様だコノヤロ」
lines.english: “Why, you—don't stand there grading me like you're so damn superior, asshole.”

lines.japanese: 「痛い痛い！　これですよ！　アナタの問題はまさにこれです！」
lines.english: “Ow, ow! This! This right here is your problem!”

lines.japanese: 「はーあ、化粧だけじゃなくて服の系統も変えてみるかー」
lines.english: “Sigh. Maybe I should change up my whole wardrobe along with my makeup.”

lines.japanese: 「それなら、男というものは制服に弱い。大学に制服姿で行けば自然と声も掛けられると思うのだが、どうだろう」
lines.english: “In that case, men are powerless before a uniform. If you went to college in one, I believe they would naturally begin approaching you.”

lines.japanese: 「あの、気がついたら自然な流れのように会話に入ってくるのやめてもらえませんか」
lines.english: “Could you please stop slipping into the conversation as though you'd been part of it all along?”

lines.japanese: 「大体、こんなフリフリのコスチューム着て大学行くって、どんだけ目立ちたがりですか。守衛さんに捕まるのが関の山ですよ」
lines.english: “Besides, if she went to college in this frilly costume, she'd look desperate for attention. Campus security would throw her out.”

lines.japanese: 「慌てるな早漏、誰もアレキサンダーの制服とは言ってないだろう」
lines.english: “Easy, Quick Draw. No one said it had to be the Alexander uniform.”

lines.japanese: 「制服、それは男の情欲を煽る不思議な衣！　日野君には、玉泉君の通う美空学園の制服を着ていただきたい。白い制服と黒い性格のギャップが燃えるだろう？」
lines.english: “A uniform: that mystic raiment which inflames the lust of man! I propose that Miss Hino wear the uniform of Misora Academy, where Miss Tamaizumi studies. Would not the contrast between a white uniform and her black personality set your blood aflame?”

lines.japanese: 「いえ、べつに」
lines.english: “No. Not especially.”

lines.japanese: 「だが困ったことに、柳木原周辺の学校制服を集めている俺のコレクションの中にも、美空学園の制服だけは存在しないのだ。あの学園はガードが厳しくてな」
lines.english: “Unfortunately, though my collection contains uniforms from schools throughout the Yanagihara area, Misora Academy's alone is absent. Security at that school is unusually tight.”

lines.japanese: 「ガードって、じゃあアナタそれ以外の制服はどういう手段で手に入れてんすか」
lines.english: “Security? Then how'd you get your hands on all those other uniforms?”

lines.japanese: 「フフフ。そんなことを言いつつも、おまえだって日野君が美空学園の制服を着ていたら嬉しいだろう？　正直に言ってみろ」
lines.english: “Heh heh heh. You may say that, but you too would be delighted to see Miss Hino in a Misora Academy uniform. Be honest.”

lines.japanese: 「いえ、べつに」
lines.english: “No. Not especially.”

lines.japanese: 「へーえ？」
lines.english: “Oh, really?”

lines.japanese: 「なんだ、相変わらず精力に乏しい男だな。よし、それでは玉泉君だったならどうだ」
lines.english: “What a man of meager vigor you remain. Very well, then. What if it were Miss Tamaizumi?”

lines.japanese: 「……うわ、引くわ」
lines.english: “…Wow. That's disturbing.”

lines.japanese: 「ちょ、ちょっと待ってくださいよ！　一瞬考えてみただけじゃないすか！　そもそも日和子さんは美空学園の生徒さんでしょ、むしろ美空学園の制服がデフォルトですよ」
lines.english: “W-wait a minute! I only pictured it for a second! Besides, Hiyoko is a Misora Academy student. Her school uniform is her default outfit!”

lines.japanese: 「あーあ、オトコってやっぱり制服とかそういうのに憧れんのかねー」
lines.english: “Jeez, I guess guys really do fantasize about uniforms and stuff.”

lines.japanese: 「聞けよオイィィィ！」
lines.english: “LISTEN TO ME, DAMMIT!”

lines.japanese: 「ちなみに俺もちょうど、女子スタッフ用ユニフォームの新案を検討していたところなのだ」
lines.english: “As it happens, I too have been considering new designs for the female staff uniform.”

lines.japanese: 「そんなの勝手に作ったって、本部の許可が下りないと使えないんじゃないんすか？」
lines.english: “Even if you make one yourself, we can't use it without approval from headquarters, can we?”

lines.japanese: 「いい質問だ鷲介。実はこの間の店長会議でな、料理の新メニューを考案してその売り上げが奮った場合、レギュラーメニューとして採用されるという話があった」
lines.english: “An excellent question, Shusuke. At the recent managers' meeting, we were told that if we devise a new dish and it sells well, headquarters may add it to the regular menu.”

lines.japanese: 「ならば制服をこちらから提案することも問題はあるまい」
lines.english: “In that case, there can be no objection to our proposing a new uniform as well.”

lines.japanese: 「なんかどうせしょーもないオチな気はしますが、どうします英里子さん」
lines.english: “I'm sure this is headed for a pathetic punch line, but what do you think, Eriko?”

lines.japanese: 「いま逃げてもどうせあとで見せられんでしょ、テキトーに相手しときな」
lines.english: “If we run now, he'll only show us later. Let's humor him and get it over with.”

lines.japanese: 「うむ、さすがは日野君だ。話が分かる。ではさっそく一つめの案――」
lines.english: “Indeed. I knew you would understand, Miss Hino. Then let us begin with my first proposal—”

lines.japanese: 「複数あるんだ！」
lines.english: “There's more than one!?”

lines.japanese: 「じゃんっ！　どうだ、テーマは夏！　見よ、この清涼感と機能性を併せもつ動きやすいデザイン！」
lines.english: “Ta-da! What do you think? The theme is summer! Behold this easy-to-move-in design, combining refreshing coolness with flawless utility!”

lines.japanese: 「話は戻りますけど英里子さん、時期的に出会いが少ないだけじゃないっすか？　年が明けて出会いの季節になれば、またキャンパス女王・みんなのえーりん復活ですって」
lines.english: “Anyway, Eriko, maybe you just haven't been meeting many people lately? Once the new year rolls around and meeting season starts, the queen of campus—everyone's own Eri—will make her comeback.”

lines.japanese: 「おっ、いいこと言うじゃん千歳。だよねえ。なんせ、おまえにも恋愛運が傾いてくるくらいだもんね」
lines.english: “Hey, now you're talking, Chitose. Yeah, exactly. I mean, even your love life's finally looking up.”

lines.japanese: 「……おい。いいんだなおまえら。この俺の案が本部に採用されて金一封が贈られてきても、おまえらには何も奢ってやらないからな」
lines.english: “…Fine. When headquarters adopts my proposal and rewards me with a handsome bonus, don't expect me to buy either of you so much as a drink.”

lines.japanese: 「いや、だって！　お言葉ですがソレ、たぶん風営法的な何かに引っかかりますよ！」
lines.english: “No, come on! With all due respect, I'm pretty sure that violates some kind of adult-entertainment law!”

lines.japanese: 「制服っていうかただの下着だしな」
lines.english: “It's not a uniform. It's just underwear.”

lines.japanese: 「そうか、仕方ない。では次のデザイン案を見てくれ」
lines.english: “I see. Very well. Then examine my next design proposal.”

lines.japanese: 「もういいよ！」
lines.english: “Enough already!”

lines.japanese: さて、そろそろ時間も書き入れ時。
lines.english: By now, the dinner rush was almost upon us.

lines.japanese: 下準備もぼちぼち整ったんで、ちょっと今のうちにトイレでもいっときましょっかね。
lines.english: Prep's pretty much done, so I might as well go to the bathroom while I've got the chance.

lines.japanese: とか思いながら一階のトイレを覗くと、どなたかがご使用中――ちぇっ。
lines.english: With that thought, I looked into the ground-floor restroom and found it occupied. Damn.

lines.japanese: 仕方ないから二階のトイレに行こうっと。でもあそこ一階より狭いし、男女兼用だからお客さんの使用率高いんだよなあ。
lines.english: No choice but to use the one upstairs. It was smaller than the one downstairs, unisex, and much more heavily used.

lines.japanese: 「鷲介さん、あの、ちょっと……」
lines.english: “Shusuke, um... Could you come here a moment?”

lines.japanese: 「へっ？」
lines.english: “Huh?”

lines.japanese: と思ったら、二階のトイレからどこかで聞いた声が。ていうかこの声って……。
lines.english: Just then, I heard a familiar voice coming from the upstairs restroom. Wait, isn't that...?

lines.japanese: くいっ　くいっ
lines.english: Twitch, twitch.

lines.japanese: あれ、なんかドアから手が出てる。
lines.english: Huh. A hand was sticking out through the door.

lines.japanese: しかも指を狐みたいにして、小さく手招きしています。
lines.english: Its fingers formed a little fox head, beckoning me in tiny motions.

lines.japanese: 「な、なにしてんすか日和子さん」
lines.english: “Wh-what are you doing, Hiyoko?”

lines.japanese: 「いいからちょっと」
lines.english: “Never mind. Just come here.”

lines.japanese: 「はあ」
lines.english: “All right…”

lines.japanese: なんだろ？　ていうかこの手、日和子さんでいいんだよ――
lines.english: What was this about? And was this hand really Hiyoko's—

lines.japanese: 無防備に近づいたら急にドアが大きく開いて、小さな狐が俺の手首に噛みついてきました。
lines.english: The instant I approached without a care, the door flew open and the little fox bit down on my wrist.

lines.japanese: 突然のことに平衡を失い、大して力のない腕に引きずりこまれてしまう俺の体。
lines.english: Caught off guard, I lost my balance and got dragged inside by an arm that wasn't even very strong.
“Whoa!”

lines.japanese: 「あたっ！」
lines.english: “Ow!”

lines.japanese: な、なにっ？　ななな、なにごと？
lines.english: Wh-what? Wh-wh-what was happening?

lines.japanese: びっくりして壁に手をついた拍子に、照明のスイッチを切ってしまったみたいです。
lines.english: In my surprise, I braced a hand against the wall and apparently hit the light switch, plunging the room into darkness.

lines.japanese: 勢いで中にいた人とぶつかってしまいました。ていうか元々トイレはお一人様用。二人も入るのが間違ってるってもんです。
lines.english: My momentum carried me into the person already inside. Then again, the restroom was designed for one. Trying to fit two people inside had been a mistake from the start.
“Ah…”

lines.japanese: 胸の中から吐息のような声が漏れました。たとえ暗くても間違えるはずはありません、玉泉日和子さんです。
lines.english: A breath of a voice escaped from somewhere against my chest. Darkness or no darkness, I could not have mistaken her. It was Hiyoko Tamaizumi.

lines.japanese: 闇の中、衝突した瞬間のまま、俺と彼女の体は重なり合っていました。今も感触が伝わってくるほど密着しています。
lines.english: Our bodies remained entangled in the dark exactly as they had fallen at the instant of impact, pressed so close that I could feel every point of contact.

lines.japanese: それどころか、体を支えるため前へ出した右足が艶めかしい弾力に挟まれています。
lines.english: More than that, the right leg I had thrown forward to catch my balance was trapped between two sensuously springy surfaces.

lines.japanese: 俺の大腿部に乗っかってくる肉圧は、ひ、日和子さんの脚……？　ちょっと前に出すと、むにっとした質感が伝わってきました。
lines.english: The soft pressure bearing down on my thigh was coming from H-Hiyoko's legs…? When I edged forward, yielding flesh pressed back.

lines.japanese: うわ、日和子さんの太もも柔らかっ！
lines.english: Whoa. Hiyoko's thighs were so soft!

lines.japanese: あ、あれ？　でもなんでこんな、素足の感触……？　だって日和子さんの仕事着はロングスカートのはず……。
lines.english: W-wait. Why could I feel her bare skin…? Hiyoko's work uniform had a long skirt…

lines.japanese: 「あ、あのっ！」
lines.english: “U-um!”

lines.japanese: 俺が不思議がってそのままでいると、日和子さんが羞恥に耐えかねたような声を出しました。
lines.english: I remained where I was, puzzling over the mystery, until Hiyoko spoke in a voice that could endure the shame no longer.

lines.japanese: 「す、すみません、いきなりこんな……」
lines.english: “I-I'm sorry. Pulling you in so suddenly…”

lines.japanese: 「いや、大丈夫です……」
lines.english: “No, it's all right…”

lines.japanese: ていうか。
lines.english: But wait.

lines.japanese: ていうかていうかていうか！
lines.english: Wait, wait, wait!

lines.japanese: 俺は壁に手を伸ばして、さっき消してしまった照明のスイッチを入れなおしました。
lines.english: I reached for the wall and switched back on the light I had accidentally turned off.

lines.japanese: 「ど、どどどどうしたんすかその格好！」
lines.english: “Wh-wh-wh-what are you wearing!?”

lines.japanese: どこかで見た白い服……だと思ったら、日和子さんは美空学園の制服を着て、俺の前に立っていました。
lines.english: Hiyoko stood before me in a familiar white outfit—the uniform of Misora Academy.

lines.japanese: 「きのう鷲介さんが、学校の制服を見たいと言ってたので……」
lines.english: “Yesterday, you said you wanted to see my school uniform…”
“Wh-what?”

lines.japanese: きのう？　きのう俺そんなこと言った？　え、持ってきたって本の話じゃないの？　ああ、そういや言ったような気もするけど！
lines.english: Yesterday? Had I said that yesterday? Wasn't the thing she'd brought supposed to be a book? Oh. Come to think of it, I might have said something like that!

lines.japanese: 「でも、他のひとに見られるのは恥ずかしいので……」
lines.english: “But I'd be embarrassed if anyone else saw me…”

lines.japanese: いや、だからって……な、なにもここここんな密室で……ちょっ、うそ、距離近くないすか……。
lines.english: Even so… d-did it have to be in this tiny locked room…? W-wait, weren't we standing awfully close…?

lines.japanese: 「あの……どーすか」
lines.english: “Um… how do I look?”

lines.japanese: 日和子さんはスカートの下端をくいくい引っぱりながら、真っ赤な顔でこちらの様子を窺っています。
lines.english: Hiyoko tugged nervously at the hem of her skirt and watched for my reaction, her face scarlet.

lines.japanese: あまりの可愛さに、俺は言葉を失ってしまいました。
lines.english: She was so adorable that every word deserted me.

lines.japanese: 「すみません、せめてなにか言ってください」
lines.english: “Please. Say something, at least.”

lines.japanese: 日和子さんは羞恥に耐えきれなくなったのか、俺に言葉を促してきました。
lines.english: Unable to bear the embarrassment any longer, Hiyoko pleaded with me to speak.

lines.japanese: すごいことです。あの玉泉日和子が恥ずかしさに耐えて、震えています。ていうかちょっと涙目になってません？
lines.english: This was extraordinary. Hiyoko Tamaizumi herself was trembling as she fought through her shame. Were her eyes actually filling with tears?

lines.japanese: 「あ、あのっ」
lines.english: “U-um!”

lines.japanese: このままなにも言わずに凝視していたら、彼女は座りこんでしまうのではないでしょうか。それもいいな。いや変態か。
lines.english: If I kept staring without a word, she might sink to the floor. That could be nice. No, what was I, some kind of pervert?

lines.japanese: 逃げ場のないこの密室で彼女が作ったわずかな隙間を、俺は一歩踏みだして埋めました。
lines.english: I stepped forward and closed the scant distance she had managed to put between us in this room with no escape.

lines.japanese: 「昨夜の続きをします」
lines.english: “I'm going to continue where we left off last night.”

lines.japanese: 恐怖心を与えないように、ゆっくりと細い体を包みこみました。
lines.english: Moving slowly so as not to frighten her, I folded her slender body into my arms.

lines.japanese: 彼女の髪の香りが妙に俺の官能を刺激します。キンモクセイの香りが邪魔だなあ、なんて思ったりしつつ。
lines.english: The scent of her hair stirred my senses with a strange intensity. I found myself wishing the sweet osmanthus perfume would stop getting in the way.

lines.japanese: 彼女はぴくんと体を震わせたものの、俺の腕を振りはらおうとはしませんでした。
lines.english: Her body gave a tiny shiver, but she made no attempt to push my arms away.

lines.japanese: 「こっち向いてください」
lines.english: “Turn around and face me.”

lines.japanese: 「恥ずかしくて死んじゃいそうなので無理です」
lines.english: “I can't. I'm so embarrassed I might die.”

lines.japanese: 「だって俺に見せるために着てきてくれたんでしょ」
lines.english: “But you wore it to show me, didn't you?”

lines.japanese: 「え、ええと、まだ心の準備が……」
lines.english: “W-well, I'm still not ready…”

lines.japanese: 「心の準備心の準備って、いつになったら心の準備ができるんですかアナタは」
lines.english: “Ready, ready—you keep saying that. When exactly are you going to be ready?”

lines.japanese: 「き、機会があれば……」
lines.english: “I-if the opportunity presents itself…”

lines.japanese: 横向いた瞬間を狙って、腕の中で彼女を引きよせました。
lines.english: I waited for the instant she looked aside, then pulled her closer in my arms.

lines.japanese: 驚くほど軽い彼女の体は、簡単に俺の胸へ収まりました。
lines.english: Her astonishingly light body slipped easily against my chest.

lines.japanese: 驚いた顔の日和子さんを無視して、ずいと顔を近付けます。
lines.english: Ignoring Hiyoko's startled expression, I leaned my face in toward hers.

lines.japanese: 「あのっ」
lines.english: “Um…”

lines.japanese: 「さっき」
lines.english: “Earlier…”

lines.japanese: 俺は腕の力をぐっと強めて、彼女の体を引きよせました。
lines.english: I tightened my arms and pulled her firmly against me.

lines.japanese: 細いのに柔らかさを感じる確かな感触。
lines.english: Slender as she was, the body in my arms had an undeniable softness.

lines.japanese: 「更衣室で呼んでくれたときから、ちょっと時間あるじゃないすか」
lines.english: “It's been a while since you called me to the changing room, hasn't it?”

lines.japanese: 「は、はい」
lines.english: “Y-yes.”

lines.japanese: 「あれからずっとここに居たんすか」
lines.english: “Have you been in here ever since?”

lines.japanese: 「あ、いえあのっ！」
lines.english: “Oh, no, um!”

lines.japanese: 彼女は悪戯が見つかった子どもみたいに首を振りました。真面目な彼女のこと、さぼっていたと思われるのが嫌だったのかもしれません。
lines.english: She shook her head like a child caught in mischief. Knowing how earnest she was, perhaps she hated the thought that I might believe she had been shirking her work.

lines.japanese: 「一度諦めて着替えた……んですけど、やっぱりどうしても鷲介さんに見てほしくて」
lines.english: “I gave up once and changed back… but I still wanted you to see me so badly.”

lines.japanese: 「もう一度着替えて、ここに隠れてました」
lines.english: “So I changed again and hid in here.”

lines.japanese: 瞬間、俺の体に震えと熱が同時に走りました。その間、この密室で日和子さんがどんな気持ちで待っていてくれたのかと思うと……。
lines.english: In that instant, heat and trembling swept through my body together. When I imagined how Hiyoko must have felt as she waited for me in this locked little room…

lines.japanese: あ、ダメだ。ダメダメ、これ無理。これ抑えるの無理です。
lines.english: No. This was bad. Bad, bad. I couldn't do it. There was no holding this back.

lines.japanese: 俺は密室の圧迫感にも後押しされて、彼女に顔を近づけました。
lines.english: With the close walls themselves seeming to urge me onward, I brought my face close to hers.

lines.japanese: 「ちょ、ちょっと待って……！」
lines.english: “W-wait…!”

lines.japanese: 「心の準備はもういいです」
lines.english: “You've had enough time to prepare.”

lines.japanese: 「あの、そうじゃなくて――」
lines.english: “No, that's not what I mean—”

lines.japanese: 「――まだ、感想聞いてないです」
lines.english: “—you still haven't told me what you think.”
“Huh?”

lines.japanese: 彼女は少し俯き加減に、胸元のスカーフに目を落としました。
lines.english: She bowed her head slightly and lowered her eyes to the scarf at her breast.

lines.japanese: 「見てほしかったんです」
lines.english: “I wanted you to see me.”

lines.japanese: 「はっ？」
lines.english: “What?”

lines.japanese: 「どすか」
lines.english: “How do I look?”

lines.japanese: 彼女の顔は真顔でした。こんな、分かりきった感想を真剣に求めているのです。
lines.english: Her face was perfectly solemn. She was asking in all seriousness for an answer so obvious it scarcely needed saying.

lines.japanese: そんなもの一目見たときから答えは決まっていたんですが、俺はこのいじらしい日和子さんを見て、さっきまでの愛情を超えて、更に超えてどこまでも超えて、彼女を抱きしめたいと思いました。
lines.english: I had known the answer from the moment I saw her. But the sight of Hiyoko trying so bravely and earnestly made my affection rise beyond what I had felt before, and beyond that, and beyond all measure, until I wanted nothing more than to hold her.

lines.japanese: 「ほ、ほほほ……」

lines.english: “You…?”

lines.japanese: 「惚れなおすにも程がある！」
lines.english: “There ought to be a limit to how hard you can make me fall for you!”

lines.japanese: 「えええっ」
lines.english: “What?!”

lines.japanese: 俺は日和子さんへのブランニュー愛情を強く抱きしめることで表現しました。
lines.english: I expressed this brand-new surge of love for Hiyoko by crushing her in my arms.

lines.japanese: 「好きです」
lines.english: “I love you.”

lines.japanese: 「はっ？」
lines.english: “What?”

lines.japanese: 「日和子さんのことが真面目に好きです」
lines.english: “I'm seriously in love with you, Hiyoko.”

lines.japanese: 「そ、それ感想じゃありません、恥ずかしいこと言わないでください」
lines.english: “Th-that's not an opinion. Please don't say such embarrassing things.”

lines.japanese: 「伝わりませんか」
lines.english: “Am I not getting the point across?”

lines.japanese: 「い、いえ、あのっ」
lines.english: “N-no, um…”

lines.japanese: 日和子さんは見て分かるくらい顔を赤くしながら、困ったように目を逸らしました。
lines.english: Hiyoko's face turned visibly red, and she looked away at a loss.

lines.japanese: 「嬉しい、です……」
lines.english: “It makes me… happy.”

lines.japanese: 「でも私、なんて答えればいいか……」
lines.english: “But I don't know what I'm supposed to say…”

lines.japanese: 「じゃあ答えなくていいです」
lines.english: “Then you don't have to say anything.”

lines.japanese: 「えっ」
lines.english: “What?”

lines.japanese: 「無回答は愛だと受けとらせていただきます」
lines.english: “I'll take silence as a declaration of love.”

lines.japanese: 俺は日和子さんに唇を重ねました。
lines.english: I pressed my lips to Hiyoko's.

lines.japanese: 唇の稜線を重ねるだけの柔らかいキス。
lines.english: A soft kiss, no more than the contours of our lips meeting.

lines.japanese: その触れあう瞬間に、日和子さんは生えそろった睫毛を静かに伏せました。
lines.english: At the instant they touched, Hiyoko quietly lowered her thick lashes.
“Mm…”

lines.japanese: 一瞬だけ、日和子さんの両腕に力がこもるのを感じました。
lines.english: For a single instant, I felt both her arms tense.

lines.japanese: でもその一瞬だけで、すぐに彼女の体から力が抜けていくのが伝わってきます。
lines.english: Only for that instant. Almost at once, I felt the tension leave her body.

lines.japanese: 俺は重ねた自分の唇で、彼女の唇を表面だけ軽くなぞっていきました。
lines.english: Keeping my lips against hers, I lightly traced the surface of her mouth.
“Nnh…”

lines.japanese: 肌が触れあう感触にくすぐったさが伝わってくると、彼女にも同じ感触が伝わっているんだな、と思いました。
lines.english: The brush of skin against skin sent a ticklish sensation through me, and I imagined she must be feeling it too.

lines.japanese: その証拠に、同じ動作を繰りかえしていくと、彼女の肌が少し震えてきたのが分かります。
lines.english: Sure enough, as I repeated the motion, I felt her skin begin to tremble.

lines.japanese: 俺はその震えを感じとると、彼女を抱いていた右腕を緩めて、体の正面へ回しました。
lines.english: The moment I sensed that tremor, I loosened the right arm around her and slipped my hand around to the front of her body.

lines.japanese: もちろん抵抗が予想されたので、今まで軽く触れていただけの唇を深く沈めて、無言の圧力をかけていきます。
lines.english: I expected resistance, so I deepened what had been a feather-light kiss and pressed my silent advantage.

lines.japanese: 「ん、んんっ」
lines.english: “Mm, mmm…”

lines.japanese: そっと挟むように彼女の下唇を吸いあげました。
lines.english: I gently caught her lower lip between mine and sucked on it.

lines.japanese: そうやって日和子さんの意識をキスに集中させている間、俺は彼女の心臓の上へ当てた手にそっと力を込めました。
lines.english: While the kiss held Hiyoko's attention, I laid my hand over her heart and slowly pressed down.

lines.japanese: いつか不可抗力で触れた感触が、今度は確かなものとして俺の指に伝わってきます。
lines.english: My fingers rediscovered with perfect certainty what they had once touched by accident.

lines.japanese: あのときは探求反射のせいで（ということにしてあります）意思とは無関係に動いた指ですが、いまは明確に俺の意思として彼女の膨らみへ食いこんでいきます。
lines.english: That first time, my fingers had moved independently of my will, driven by the orienting reflex—or so I had decided. Now, of my own clear intent, they sank into the swell of her breast.

lines.japanese: もにゅっ、です。あのとき不可抗力で触れたもにゅっ、とは違います。愛と情熱のもにゅっ、です。
lines.english: Squish. Not the accidental squish of that first encounter. This was a squish filled with love and passion.

lines.japanese: その手に彼女の手が重なったので、抵抗させないように唇を強く吸いあげました。
lines.english: Her hand came down over mine. To keep her from resisting, I sucked harder on her lips.

lines.japanese: 「んむっ……」
lines.english: “Mmm…”

lines.japanese: 触れた手がぴくんと反応して動きが止まりました。
lines.english: The hand over mine twitched, then went still.

lines.japanese: 俺は舌を伸ばして日和子さんの唇をなぞり、その重なりを割って口内へ侵入しようとしました。
lines.english: I extended my tongue and traced Hiyoko's lips, trying to part them and enter her mouth.

lines.japanese: 彼女は顎を強張らせて門を閉ざしました。しかし俺が胸へ当てた手に運動を加えると、唇の守りは薄くなってゆきました。
lines.english: Her jaw clenched, barring the gate. But when the hand against her breast began to move, the defense of her lips gradually weakened.

lines.japanese: 「んっ、んっ、んんーっ……」
lines.english: “Mm, mm, mmmm…”

lines.japanese: 俺の手で弄ばれた日和子さんが、切なそうに息を漏らしています。
lines.english: Toyed with beneath my hand, Hiyoko released a breathless, yearning moan.

lines.japanese: ああ、なんか日和子さんが素直で嬉しいなあ。よし、もっといじめてしまおう。
lines.english: Man, it made me happy to see Hiyoko being so responsive. All right, time to tease her some more.

lines.japanese: 俺の舌は日和子さんの唇を割って侵入し、彼女の舌を絡めとろうと口内で乱暴に動きました――
lines.english: My tongue forced Hiyoko's lips apart and plunged inside, moving roughly through her mouth in pursuit of her own—

lines.japanese: こんこん
lines.english: Knock, knock.

lines.japanese: ――と思ったら背後のドアから音がしました。
lines.english: —when a sound came from the door behind me.
“Gah!”

lines.japanese: 俺を押さえていた手に力がこもる日和子さん。そして俺に背を向けてしまいました。
lines.english: Hiyoko's restraining hand tightened. Then she turned her back on me.

lines.japanese: 「あ、あのっ、どうしましょう……」
lines.english: “U-um... What should we do?”

lines.japanese: 俺は少し、いやかなり名残り惜しかったのですが、状況を冷静に判断して、小さく頭を垂れました。
lines.english: I was reluctant to stop—a little, or rather, tremendously reluctant—but I assessed the situation coolly and bowed my head.

lines.japanese: そして彼女が恥ずかしい思いをしなくて済むよう、外にも聞こえる白々しい声を出しました。
lines.english: Then, to spare her embarrassment, I raised my voice with elaborate innocence so the person outside could hear.

lines.japanese: 「あ～、こりゃダメっすね。玉泉先輩、やっぱ壊れてますわ」
lines.english: “Ah, no good. Ms. Tamaizumi, you were right—it's definitely broken.”

lines.japanese: 「ああ、お客様、申しわけございませんがこの階のトイレは故障しておりますので、一階トイレのご利用をお願いいたします」
lines.english: “My apologies, but the restroom on this floor is out of order. Please use the restroom downstairs.”

lines.japanese: 舌打ちと「なんだよ」という声がして、ドアの前から人の気配が消えました。
lines.english: A tongue clicked, someone muttered, ‘Oh, come on,’ and the presence outside the door receded.

lines.japanese: 「ええ、それじゃあまあ」
lines.english: “Right, then...”

lines.japanese: 「先、行ってます」
lines.english: “I'll go on ahead.”

lines.japanese: 俺は後ろ向きの日和子さんに、出来るだけ落ちついた声で話しかけました。
lines.english: I addressed Hiyoko's turned back in the calmest voice I could manage.

lines.japanese: 「あ、はい、いってらっしゃい」

lines.japanese: 彼女は小さくこくんとうなずいて、それ以上の返事はしませんでした。
lines.english: She gave one small nod and said nothing more.

lines.japanese: 「はあー」
lines.english: “Whew…”

lines.japanese: ドアを開けてこっそりとフロアに戻る俺。そういや仕事中だっつうのに。
lines.english: I cracked open the door and slipped back onto the floor. Come to think of it, we were still in the middle of work.

lines.japanese: と、努めて冷静に考えてはみるものの、まだもにゅもにゅとした感情が頭の中から離れません。
lines.english: Try as I might to think calmly, however, I could not get those soft, yielding sensations out of my head.

lines.japanese: さてどうしたもんかねえ。
lines.english: What was I supposed to do now?

lines.japanese: や、まあ、気持ちの整理はあとにして、いまは喜んでおきますか。
lines.english: Well, I could sort out my feelings later. For now, I might as well celebrate.

lines.japanese: 「いいいやっほおおおおい」
lines.english: “YEEEEEE-HAAAAAA!”

lines.japanese: 日和子さんとキスしちゃった～い！
lines.english: I kissed Hiyokooo!

lines.japanese: 俺は軽くステップを踏みながら階段を下っていきました。
lines.english: I skipped lightly down the stairs.

lines.japanese: 途中、踏みはずして転げおちました。
lines.english: Halfway down, I missed a step and tumbled to the bottom.
